sloka: स मारुत इवाकाशं मारुतस्यात्मसम्भवः ।प्रपेदे हरिशार्दूलो दक्षिणादुत्तरां दिशम् ।। 5.56.25 ।।।।
transliteration: sa māruta ivākāśaṁ mārutasyātmasambhavaḥ ।prapede hariśārdūlo dakṣiṇāduttarāṁ diśam ।। 5.56.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys leaped into the sky like the Windgod from the south to the north shore.
